Item 54 prints decimals with a raised dot (12·34, 13·10), recorded as ordinary decimal points. Item 75 prints its options in a 2x2 grid ((a) (b) on one line, (c) (d) on the next); order kept a, b, c, d. Item 71(d) prints the case name in italics (A. K. Gopalan vs. State of Madras); italics dropped. Item 62's List-I/List-II is a pipe table in the stem (single item, so no context). No shared contexts, no figure items.
